subject: aria_nbv.rri_metrics module architecture cleanup

non_goals: Do not change target-conditioned scoring semantics.
Do not rewrite VIN, Lightning, app panels, rollouts, or data_handling beyond mechanical import retargeting during later execution.
Do not add broad compatibility facades unless a public contract test proves a stable external import.

context_heavy_evidence.note: make context-heavy source ladder and generated timestamp
current rri_metrics tree with shallow logging/reporting folders and broad metrics package

decision.summary: Use one justified nested module family, rri_metrics.rollout, while collapsing shallow logging/reporting folders, removing broad midpoint reexports, and keeping DTOs producer-local unless they are stable cross-seam contracts.
dto_policy: Return-shape DTOs live beside the producer function.
Diagnostic DTOs live beside diagnostic producers.
Config/factory DTOs live beside the constructed class.
Do not create types/rollout.py unless a real cycle or stable cross-seam contract appears.
public_import_policy: Delete or narrow the broad rri_metrics.metrics.__all__ midpoint surface.
Prefer leaf imports such as rri_metrics.rollout.returns and rri_metrics.rollout.diagnostics.
Keep rollout/__init__.py, oracle/__init__.py, and objectives/__init__.py empty or narrow.

work_packages.title: Lock public intent
work_packages.summary: Strengthen public API tests so the root stays compact and midpoint barrels cannot reappear unnoticed.

work_packages.title: Collapse shallow folders
work_packages.summary: Move logging/names.py to logging.py and reporting/plotting.py to plotting.py; update only mechanical imports and docs refs.

work_packages.title: Split rollout metrics by semantic role
work_packages.summary: Create rollout/returns.py, rollout/diagnostics.py, rollout/tables.py, and rollout/torchmetrics.py. Keep selected_path_length_tensor in diagnostics.

work_packages.title: Type and document TorchMetric states
work_packages.summary: Add class-level Tensor annotations and field docstrings for every add_state tensor, plus a focused state-contract test.

work_packages.title: Collapse the old metrics package
work_packages.summary: Move point_mesh to distance.py and one-step reducers/TorchMetrics to single_step.py; delete or narrow metrics/__init__.py.

work_packages.title: Keep oracle and objectives narrow
work_packages.summary: Keep oracle/ and objectives/ as justified subpackages for the first pass; do not rename objectives/ to ordinal/ in this cleanup.

validation_plan: cd aria_nbv && uv run ruff format --check aria_nbv/rri_metrics tests/rri_metrics
cd aria_nbv && uv run ruff check aria_nbv/rri_metrics tests/rri_metrics
cd aria_nbv && uv run pytest tests/rri_metrics
cd aria_nbv && uv run pytest tests/vin/test_rri_binning.py tests/vin/test_coral.py
cd aria_nbv && uv run pytest tests/lightning/test_vin_batch_collate.py
cd aria_nbv && uv run pytest tests/rollouts/test_counterfactuals.py
implementation_cautions: All cross-surface edits outside rri_metrics should be mechanical import retargeting only.
Keep _histogram_overlay and _plot_hist_counts_mpl owned by utils.plotting, not re-exported from rri_metrics.plotting.
Keep private helpers in the leaf that uses them; do not add rollout/utils.py without a real cycle or repeated helper body.
Keep DistanceBreakdown in types.py for the first pass.
Do not recreate metrics.__all__ through rollout/__init__.py, oracle/__init__.py, or objectives/__init__.py.
